answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 14922 Country: India Title: Assalamu Alaikum, I want to name my new born son as Arhaan Abbas. Please let me know if this is a proper Islamic name. Also,can you tell me meaning of Arhaan. wassalam Question: Assalamu Alaikum, I want to name my new born son as Arhaan Abbas. Please let me know if this is a proper Islamic name. Also,can you tell me meaning of Arhaan. wassalam Answer ID: 14922 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1301/1237=B/1430) We neither know what Arhaan means and to which language it belongs. Instead, you should keep his name as Raihan Abbas. Raihan means: flower. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
